title: xDrip followers sync feature dead after Google FCM API removed on 22.07.2024
body:
I know, I didn't consult the developers first, but that's not a "bug", just a major f*ck up... so I'm just trying to get @jamorham attention :)

### Subject of the issue
Google FCM old API was removed yesterday causing major issue for all xdrip followers. It seems it was announced a year ago, but nothing was done in this time.
https://firebase.google.com/support/faq#deprecated-api-shutdown

Not an mobile expert but I really hope that Firebase SDK upgrade (15.0.0 -> 24.0.0) in xDrip should be enough to fix the problem.

### Your environment
Doesn't matter - all apps using the FCM messaging API are affected.

### Expected behavior
Followers working like two days ago

### Actual behavior
Communication between master and followers broken using default sync.

Update to the release of 2024.09.15b or any after that.

Make sure to enable the setting `Use xDrip Cloud` on the xDrip Sync Settings page on the master and followers.
![Screenshot_20240915-080324](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1cfa503-4215-4ac4-887c-8960aaa69911)

If everything worked fine for you before and enabling the new setting causes problems, disable the setting on the master and followers and inform us.
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3664

Its super fast, it sync bg, sensor age and sensor statuses, remote snooze, treatments etc.

Well, it's not dead any more.
All the details are here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3664  

In summary, you need to use the current stable release or any other after that and enable the new setting `Settings` > `xDrip Sync Settings` > `Use xDrip Cloud` on the master and all followers.
If you experience any issue, please let us know by opening a discussion.

We can reopen this if needed.
